name: QuickRepliesAsk
description:
Quick replies: a handful of short answers as pills. One tap answers; nothing else to
submit. The agent still accepts a typed reply in the composer.

props.name: ask
props.type: { type: "quick"; options: ChoiceOption[]; } & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The quick-reply ask: the question and the `options` shown as pills; one tap answers. Answers go to the `answer` conversation handler; once answered, expired or cancelled the card shows its record.
